name: spark-outpost-artifact-share
description: Hosts the pages people share from Spark Outpost.

UPLOAD_KEY.description: The key Spark Outpost must send to upload a page. Copy UPLOAD_KEY from Spark Outpost: Settings, Connectors, Cloudflare. Or use 32 to 128 letters, digits, - or _ of your own and paste the same value into Spark Outpost.

SIGNING_KEY.description: Signs page frames and unlock cookies. Copy SIGNING_KEY from Spark Outpost: Settings, Connectors, Cloudflare. Or use a random value of at least 32 characters. Nothing else needs it.
